text: Call Issued: April 6, 2018 Call Closed: May 7, 2018 Number of Addenda Issued: One (1) Number of Bids: Three (3) Table 2: Summary of Bids Received for 6141-18-0137 including Bid price * Bidder Name Evaluated Bid Price (including HST) Wheelchair Accessible Transit Inc. $131,281.14 Scarborough City Cab $348,932.70 Equinox Bus Lines Corp. $725,154.90 * Bid price per year (12 months) before inflation impacts.

The Bid Award Panel adopted the following: Call Number: Request for Quotation No. 6141-18-0137 Description: Provision of Bus Services including buses, drivers, fuel, insurance and any other related costs that may be incurred to provide transportation services for the City of Toronto's Long-Term Care Homes & Services Division to and from various Long-Term Care Homes and Services locations within the GTA and non-GTA destinations, for a period of one (1) year, from date of award to May 31, 2019, with the option to renew the Contract for four (4) additional separate one (1) year periods. Should the option(s) be exercised then the General Manager, Long-Term Care Homes and Services will request the Chief Purchasing Officer to process the renewals under the same terms and conditions. Recommended Bidder: Wheelchair Accessible Transit Inc. Contract Award Value: $106,497 net of all applicable…
